The api died at 03:14:06 because the disk filled up: a `report-export` job wrote about 20 GB to `/var/lib/stockroom` in eight minutes, and the database could no longer write. It was still down when the log ends at 05:29:57.

One thing to check first: every line in `logs/service.log` is dated 2026-03-09, not last night (today is 2026-10-08). Either this is an old or sample log, or the same failure happened again and the fresh log is elsewhere.

| Time | Event |
|---|---|
| 02:00–03:05 | Normal traffic, all requests 200. |
| 03:05:00 | `report-export` starts writing 512 MB CSV parts to `/var/lib/stockroom/exports/`, one every 12 seconds. |
| 03:09:03 | `WARN disk /var/lib/stockroom at 91%`. |
| 03:12:48 | Last export part written (41 in total, about 20.5 GB). |
| 03:13:30 | `WARN disk /var/lib/stockroom at 99%`. |
| 03:14:00 | `ERROR db: could not extend file "base/16384/2619": No space left on device`. |
| 03:14:03 | `ERROR api: transaction aborted, shutting down worker pool`. |
| 03:14:06 | `FATAL api: exiting (status 1)`. |
| 03:16:00–05:28:00 | `proxy: upstream api refused connection` every two minutes (67 times). |

- **Still down at end of log:** there are no api requests after 03:13:51 and no sign of the api coming back, even though compose has `restart: unless-stopped`. The log doesn't say why; presumably the disk was still full.
- **Other services:** web and proxy kept serving 200s throughout.
- **Cache warnings are unrelated:** the `cache: slow command` lines appear every five minutes or so from 02:00 onwards, before and after the crash, at a steady 100–150 ms.
- **Export job source:** nothing in `scripts/` or `app/` is named `report-export`, so I couldn't see what launches it or why it wrote so much.

To recover, free space in `/var/lib/stockroom/exports/` and restart the api. To stop a repeat, the export needs a size cap or its own volume, away from the database.

Separately, the ponytail plugin's statusline badge isn't configured; say the word and I'll add it to `settings.json`.
